parameters.jsCode:
const data = $input.first().json;
const pendingId = 'PND-' + Date.now();

return [{
  json: {
    // Pending Approvals sheet columns
    ID: pendingId,
    Timestamp: data.timestamp,
    'Customer Identifier': data.customer_id,
    'Original Message': (data.message || '').substring(0, 500),
    'AI Draft Response': data.response,
    'Matched KB Entry': data.matched_kb_id ? 'KB #' + data.matched_kb_id : 'No match - AI generated from context',
    'Confidence Score': data.confidence,
    Status: 'Pending',
    'Approved By': '',
    'Final Response': '',
    'Add to KB?': '',
    'New KB Category': '',
    // Pass-through for downstream nodes
    _classification: data.classification,
    _customer_name: data.customer_name,
    _customer_id: data.customer_id,
    _source: data.source,
    _subject: data.subject,
    _thread_id: data.thread_id,
    _sentiment: data.sentiment,
    _detected_intent: data.detected_intent,
    _reasoning: data.reasoning,
    _message: data.message,
    _response: data.response,
    _confidence: data.confidence,
    _pending_id: pendingId
  }
}];
